title: Rivet 3: Figma to code token guide
readMe: Figma is the source of truth. Every token has ONE name, used the same in Figma and in code.
Code name rule: --rvt- + the Figma name with every '/' turned into '-'. Example: Figma text/default → --rvt-text-default. Figma Dev Mode shows these exact names.
'codeToday' is the name in rivet-source now (null = doesn't exist yet). 'action' says what to do: none, rename, add, value change, remove.
Naming can still be adjusted: see 'namingSuggestions'. Suggest a name and it changes in Figma first, so both sides stay identical.
Colors are hex; sizes are px; when desktop and mobile differ both are listed.

namingSuggestions.how: Want a different name? Download rename-suggestions.json from the guide, add one entry per token, and send it to Jenn. She applies it in Figma (renaming keeps every component connected), the guide regenerates, and code uses the new name. Don't rename only in code.

toDo: 1. Add generated/rivet-tokens.css (download from this guide) after the current token CSS. It defines every token with its Figma name: palette, all three themes, mobile values, text-style shorthands, shadows, and aliases for the old names so nothing breaks.
2. Make the changes in 'componentChanges' (15 visual changes, plus badge token names and the CTA hover icon token, which don't change the look).
3. Replace old names with new ones using 'migration' (search and replace; old names keep working through the aliases until you're done).
4. Apply the value changes marked 'value change' (text styles, font weight 700, font width 110%, shadows, mobile spacing).
5. Delete the deprecated aliases and the code-only tokens Jenn approves removing ('codeOnly').
After that, Figma and code match 1:1. New tokens start in Figma; name suggestions go through 'namingSuggestions'.

componentChanges.change: Tag line heights follow the type scale: one line height per size, shared with every other style at that size. tag/sm/* 12/16, tag/md/* 14/20, tag/lg/* 16/24. (Updated 2026-10-29: md and lg were 14/18 and 16/20 for a few days; the --rvt-type-line-height-18 token added for that is gone, don't add it.)
Lists use square bullets in --rvt-component-list-marker (crimson on Light, #ebd8bc on Dark and Crimson). List text matches the body text size around it.
Tab height is set by tab type and size. Container tabs are 48px (Large, Desktop) and 40px (Small, Mobile). Segmented tabs are 40px (Large) and 32px (Small). Labels stay centered vertically.

Figma now shows a Focus state on every interactive component. It matches reset.css exactly: 2px outline in border-accent-strong, 2px offset, outside the element. Checkbox and radio ring the control only; cards ring the whole card (:focus-within). No code change needed — keep the global :focus-visible rule and never remove it.

componentChanges.component: Hover fills — pagination, accordion, series nav, tabs, subnav, icon buttons

Today pagination, accordion and series nav use background-light, and tabs/subnav use background-strong; change them all to background-tint. In Dark and Crimson, tint and strong are the same color, so only Light changes.
On hover the Previous/Next label also underlines (already in the build). Fill per the hover row above.

Figma decision (2026-10-30): keep the Figma styling (same look as the larger Normal button, just smaller). The build gives small buttons a theme-ui border and accent text; match Figma instead.
Squared off: track and knob have no radius (the build uses a pill). Labels use the new switch tokens.

componentChanges.component: Avatar, Calendar tile, Steps, Feature card sticker
